title: The open and proper coordinates of the intrinsic site comparison
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $C_T$ denote the canonical etale-to-intrinsic comparison and $E_T$ the fixed-scalar-to-intrinsic realization of [def-finite-compact-scalar-transport-data]. For any open immersion $j:X\to Z$, define openRealizationIso from $E_X I_A$ to $J^{\mathrm{proet}}_A E_Z$ as the derived composition comparisons and the realization equivalence unit. Define openSiteIso from $J^{\mathrm{et}}_A C_Z$ to $C_X I_A$ by the intrinsic site factorization, the exact open site comparison, and the inverse of openRealizationIso. For any quasi-compact quasi-separated $g:Z\to Y$ and any bounded-below etale $A$-complex $H$, define properSiteIso from $C_Y(Rg_*H)$ to $P_A(C_ZH)$ as follows: first apply intrinsicSiteFunctorIso at $Y$, then the derived functor's bounded-below inclusion comparison, then the inclusion of the specified invertible fixedComparisonDirectImageMatePlus, then the proper bounded-below inclusion comparison at the target. Follow these by the inverse normalized intrinsic proper-realization comparison and the inverse intrinsicSiteFunctorIso at $Z$. Here $I_A$ is intrinsic extension by zero and $P_A$ intrinsic derived direct image. Every component is an explicit composite of the recorded canonical isomorphisms of [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison] and [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]; no new equality or arbitrary existence witness is used.

def properSiteIso (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g]
    (H : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))) :
    (ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Y A).obj
        ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          H.obj) ≅
      (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage g A).obj
        ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z A).obj H.obj)
